options.rationale: From behind on a wide road you stop and wait like on a narrow one, while from ahead across the lanes you are released.

options.text: Both release you on a wide road
options.rationale: Both release you on a wide road: this is not what the manual states. The manual says: From behind on a wide road you stop and wait like on a narrow one, while from ahead across the lanes you are released.

options.text: From behind you are released and from ahead you stop
options.rationale: From behind you are released and from ahead you stop: this is not what the manual states. The manual says: From behind on a wide road you stop and wait like on a narrow one, while from ahead across the lanes you are released.

options.text: Neither applies on a wide road
options.rationale: Neither applies on a wide road: this is not what the manual states. The manual says: From behind on a wide road you stop and wait like on a narrow one, while from ahead across the lanes you are released.

items.correct_rationale: Option A is correct: From behind on a wide road you stop and wait like on a narrow one, while from ahead across the lanes you are released.
distractor_source: synthesized near-miss: both release you on a wide road
synthesized near-miss: from behind you are released and from ahead you stop
synthesized near-miss: neither applies on a wide road
